channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Trump says regime change in Iran “the best thing that could happen”
item.description: US President Donald Trump has said that regime change in Iran would be “the best thing that could happen.”

item.title: Afghan, Iran officials meet to resolve road transport issues
item.description: Afghan and Iranian transportation officials have held talks to address challenges and remove obstacles facing road transport companies of both countries.

item.title: US, Iran may hold 2nd round of talks in Geneva on Tuesday
item.description: The United States and Iran are expected to hold a second round of negotiations on Tuesday in Geneva, Switzerland, a media report said on Saturday.

item.title: Fuel prices down, gold up in Kabul
item.description: The prices of fuel and cooking oil declined, while gold surged in outgoing week in Kabul markets, market sources said on Saturday.

item.title: Afghan, Dagestani traders ink $1.5m agreements
item.description: Afghan and Dagestani traders have inked five memoranda of understanding (MoUs) worth more than 1.5 million US dollars, the Afghanistan Chamber of Commerce and Investment (ACCI) said on Saturday.

item.title: 48 tonnes of substandard sement returned to Uzbekistan: ASQA
item.description: Two consignments totalling 48 tonnes of substandard cement have been returned to Uzbekistan via the Hairatan port, the Afghanistan Standard and Quality Authority (ASQA) said on Saturday.

item.title: 865 acres declared state land in Ghazni: MoJ
item.description: The Ministry of Justice (MoJ) has announced that 865 acres of land in the “Sultan Mahmud Ghaznavi Township” in southern Ghazni province have been declared state property based on a Sharia ruling by the Special Court.
